images.name: 01_front_right.png
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference of a two-storey Chinese xianxia village EATERY / INN (食肆客棧), a single building game asset. Style reference images (style only, do not copy their buildings): Models/StarterHouse and Models/MaterialShop renders from 強悍修仙2.0, and ArtLibrary/ExpansionBatches/KitchenWare09/overview.jpg for the props. Match softly beveled stylized 3D game art, dark chestnut timber frame, pale lime-plaster walls, blue-gray stone plinth, dark blue-gray tiled roofs with restrained upturned eaves, subdued jade/ochre accents. DESIGN: footprint about 10 m wide x 8 m deep. Ground floor: front (south) is an open dining hall with folding lattice doors fully open, four square tables (1.0 x 1.0 m) with round stools visible inside, a long serving counter on the left/west. Kitchen in the rear-right (north-east) corner with a plastered brick stove (one round wok opening, arched fire mouth) and a short stone chimney rising through the roof at the north-east. Covered front veranda 1.5 m deep on timber columns with two hanging round paper lanterns and a blank wooden signboard over the entrance (no lettering). Upper floor: three small guest rooms with lattice windows facing south, reached by an interior timber stair along the west wall; small balcony with wooden railing above the veranda. Main door height about 2.2 m for a 1.8 m character. No characters, no scenery beyond a small flat stone ground patch, neutral warm gray background, soft studio lighting, no text, no watermark. Keep structure readable, symmetrical where possible and plausible to model; avoid excessive ornament, Japanese torii or European timber framing. VIEW: front-right three quarter view from slightly above eye height. MASTER design reference: all other views must follow this image.
